zh.title: uva.xyz — 一些小东西，慢慢成熟
zh.description: uva 是葡萄。这里是我写下来的、做出来的、收藏起来的小东西，慢慢成熟。

journey.text: 把想到的东西，一颗一颗种出来。
没有公司，也没有头衔：学东西、做小工具、写开源，把想法一个个做出来。

en.title: uva.xyz — Small things, slowly ripening
en.description: uva means grape. Things I write, make and bookmark — small, and slowly ripening.

journey.text: Planting ideas, one grape at a time.
No company, no title — just learning, building small tools and open-source projects, one idea at a time.
